video_directives: Tighten the ear/pressure-wave hold (10-13s): the same static ear with a tiny jet loop outstays its beat — cut it a second earlier.
Vary the character's idle motion — he reacts per scene nicely but returns to the same lean pose between beats; add micro-shifts (weight change, head tilt) to keep mid-scene frames alive.
The final 'IT COULD DO IT ALL' card sits on an unchanged frame for the whole tail — add the character's gaze following the wave rings or a slow ring expansion to earn the hold.
